description: The line plot illustrates the Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) as a function of the number of queries used during inference for different document retrieval (DPR) methods. The x-axis is labeled "Number of queries used during inference (S)" and is linear, ranging from 1 to 10, with tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis is labeled "MRR@10" and is linear, ranging from 33.0 to 36.0, with tick labels at every 0.5 interval. The plot includes four lines representing different DPR methods: "DPR w/o query" is depicted with a black line and no markers, "DPR w/ corpus expansion" is shown with a red line and circle markers, "DPR w/ document expansion" is represented by a green line with triangle markers, and "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion" is illustrated with a blue line and star markers. The "DPR w/ corpus expansion" line shows a steady increase in MRR as the number of queries increases, starting at approximately 35.5 and ending at around 36.0. The "DPR w/ document expansion" line fluctuates slightly but generally remains around 34.5. The "DPR w/ asymmetric expansion" line shows a slight decline in MRR as the number of queries increases, starting at around 34.5 and ending at approximately 33.5. The "DPR w/o query" line remains constant at 34.0 across all query numbers.
